commit.message:
test(ui): pin viewport gizmos wearing their names (#641)

Every origin gizmo is about to carry a name: each work-offset triad
shows the entity name the Setup pane uses, the dimmed world axes show
World. Pins go red here - they fail until the labels exist.

feat(ui): viewport origin gizmos wear their names (#641)

Each work-offset triad labels its origin with the entity name the
Setup pane shows (G54, Setup2/WCS) in bright triad blue; the dimmed
world axes label theirs World in neutral gray dimmed like the lines
under them. Labels ride gizmos(), so the pane's eye and show-world-
axes gate drop a name with its lines; only X/Y/Z keep the big letter
font. setup_chip_tests' no-G54 clause narrows to plane chips - the
origin name is Setup1's own, legitimately.
fix(ui): the gizmo-name work is #727, not #641 (#641 is the lathe blade-corner fix)

feat(ui,app): the origin names get a persisted on/off switch (#645)

The rework ask on this PR: the #727 gizmo names answer to a toggle now,
default on, persisted across restarts, with a structural test covering
both states.

- `State.show_gizmo_names` (default on, the #727 decision) beside
  `show_world_axes`; the browser pane grows a "Show origin names"
  checkbox under "Show world origin axes". The flip is view state like
  every other toggle - local copy, `.changed()`, written through
  `set_gizmo_names` - never a command, never on the history - and the
  choice goes out to disk at once.
- `interact::overlay_labels` gates only the name rows: the triad lines
  and the X/Y/Z letters never depend on the switch. New law test
  `the_name_switch_quiets_names_not_letters_or_lines` pins exactly that;
  the existing #727 count tests keep passing with the flag on.
- Persistence: no view preference persists today - the only per-user
  file is the recents one - so this adds `app::view`: a sibling
  `view.json` (format `camcraft-view/1`) in the same config folder,
  built on `recent::config_dir_for` and `machine::store::write_atomic`
  like `recent` itself. Unknown-key tolerant, atomic write, creates
  missing folders. `State::load_view` reads it in `Shell::new` right
  after the recents; `state_view.rs` is the state-side wiring, mirroring
  `state_recent.rs`. The decision - and the option of folding the file
  into recent.json if the maintainer prefers - is recorded in
  docs/decisions/727-viewport-gizmo-labels.md.
- Tests: app `tests/view_prefs.rs` - round-trip, corrupt file starts
  with names on, unknown keys ride through a rewrite, the store writes
  where `CAMCRAFT_CONFIG_DIR` points; ui `egui_app::tests::view_names` -
  real checkbox clicks both ways queue nothing, the file follows the
  click, and a fresh shell over the same file keeps the choice;
  structural gains the checkbox label in the live view-toggle list.
- Pins: the new checkbox row moves the painted tree down one row
  (+21.0 = row height + item spacing), so the hardcoded browser-pane
  tree tops in tests.rs and tests/program_entry.rs move 200.0 -> 221.0,
  the same move 30479ed7 made (179.0 -> 200.0) for the Projection row.
  Pixel snapshots untouched: the release lane owns the PNGs (#255).

Gates: ui lib 448 passed / 0 failed (5 ignored), app suite green,
`cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`
clean.

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>
